name: Tsurui (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tsurui village emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised crane's head and neck.
history: Municipal flag of Tsurui, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 September 1949.

features.role: Tsurui village emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised crane's head and neck
